inputs.text: [whispers] Her shell wasn't hard like a backyard turtle's. [amazed] It was thick, tough skin, like leather — [softly] soft, almost like a wing.
[curious] A soft shell, what's that even good for?
[warmly] For swimming faster. With that shell, she flew through the water [confident] just like a leatherback turtle does today — [proud] the speed champion of all turtles.
